summary: This bill designates the Peter J. McGuire Memorial and Peter J. McGuire Gravesite in Pennsauken, New Jersey, as the "Peter J. McGuire Memorial National Commemorative Site" and authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to enter into cooperative agreements and provide assistance for educational and interpretive programs, without making it a unit of the National Park System or affecting property owners' rights.
